auth_manual.title: Sign in to Mazda
auth_manual.description:
Mobile app sign-in ends by handing off to the official app with a url that desktop browsers cannot open. Follow the instructions below and copy the callback address from a browser's developer console instead.

1. [Open the Mazda sign-in]({authorize_url}). If no sign-in page loads at all, you must clear any mazda.com cookies from your browser first.
2. Complete the Mazda sign-in form and click LOGIN. After clicking the button, **no new page loads and the browser appears to do nothing**. That is expected.
3. Open the browser's developer tools (Chrome or Edge: F12, or ⌥⌘I on a Mac) and open the **Console** tab.
4. Find a line containing `Failed to launch 'msauth://com.interrait.mymazda/...'` or similar, logged because the browser cannot open `msauth://` addresses.
5. Right-click the `msauth://` address, select **Copy link address**, and paste it below.

Keep this window open until you submit. The address is a one-time sign-in credential, so do not include it in issue reports or screenshots.
